01

“Kaf Ha Ya Ayn Sad”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 19:1).

01
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 01

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, on His words:
Kaf Ha Ya Ayn Sad [Maryam 1] he said: "Kaf: from Karim [Generous], Ha: from Hadi [Guide], Ya: from Hakim [Wise], Ayn: from Alim [Knowing], Sad: from Sadiq [Truthful]."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
كهيعص [مريم: 1] قَالَ: " كَافٌ: مِنْ كَرِيمٍ، وَهَاءٌ: مِنْ هَادٍ، وَيَاءٌ: مِنْ حَكِيمٍ، وَعَيْنٌ: مِنْ عَلِيمٍ، وَصَادٌ: مِنْ صَادِقٍ "
Edition record 372657 · p. 453Link to report ↗
02

“who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 19:6).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob [Maryam 6] he said: "His inheritance was knowledge, and Zechariah was of the descendants of Jacob."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ [مريم: 6] قَالَ: «كَانَ وِرَاثَتُهُ عِلْمًا، وَكَانَ زَكَرِيَّا مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ يَعْقُوبَ»
Edition record 372658 · p. 453Link to report ↗
03

“We have not assigned to any before him the same name”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 19:7).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
We have not assigned to any before him the same name [Maryam 7] meaning: "a like."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا [مريم: 7] ، يَعْنِي: «مَثَلًا»
Edition record 372659 · p. 454Link to report ↗

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

Explanation from Mujāhid 17

“And mention in the Book Idris; indeed, he was a truthful prophet…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 19:57).

18
Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:

وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا [مريم: 57] قَالَ: «رُفِعَ كَمَا رُفِعَ عِيسَى عليهما السلام وَلَمْ يَمُتْ»
Edition record 372674 · p. 456Link to report ↗
17

“Then there came after them successors who neglected prayer and…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 19:59).

19
Explanation from Mujāhid 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Then there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires [Maryam 59] he said: "They are those at the establishment of the Hour and the passing of the righteous of the community of Muhammad ﷺ; they will leap upon one another in the alleys, fornicators."
العربية
الإسناد
